description: Org-scoped CURRENT candidate proposals: action type/class, D-class, status with blocked_reason (blocked_on_signal proposals name the failing dimension), estimated impact, taxonomy axes. Config payloads (config_diff, guardrails, rollback mechanics) are deliberately excluded. Read-only. Response is envelope-shaped: every numeric leaf is a MeasuredValue {value, ci_low, ci_high, method, data_through}. ci fields are null unless the source payload carries a real confidence interval — never fabricated. Requires an API key with the 'read' scope.
name: metrx_get_proposals
title: Get Candidate Proposals
